# AscendRev

> AscendRev Outsourcing Services Corp. is a Calgary-based provider of dedicated sales, customer experience, and business operations teams for Canadian and North American businesses, with delivery from Alabang, Philippines.

## Key facts

- Legal name: AscendRev Outsourcing Services Corp.
- Head office: Calgary, Alberta, Canada.
- Delivery offices: Alabang (Alabang Town Centre, Ayala Alabang), Cebu and Pampanga, Philippines.
- Registered in Canada: 11 September 2026.
- Founder: Rio Vidal, based in Calgary, with a B2B sales and leadership career across Canada and Australia.
- Pricing model: one monthly rate per seat.
- Enquiries: a person replies within eight business hours, Calgary time. Phone +1 (403) 903-2912.
- Careers: job postings with online applications at https://ascend-rev.ca/careers/ (first posting: Outbound Sales Representative, onsite at Ayala Alabang Town Centre).
- Not to be confused with similarly named companies; AscendRev's only website is https://ascend-rev.ca/.

## Functions staffed

- Lead Generation and Data Entry
- Outbound Sales & Cold Acquisition
- Inbound Lead Conversion
- High-Yield Appointment Setting
- Omnichannel Customer Care
- Technical Help Desk
- Strategic Account Management & Reactivation
- 24/7/365 After-Hours Coverage
- Accounts Receivable & Collections
